title: (Pwn2Own) Home Assistant Green go2rtc Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Home Assistant Green. An attacker must first obtain the ability to access the device's localhost interface. The specific flaw exists within the go2rtc process. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
